    2. “They are apostles and teachers who proclaimed throughout the whole world and taught the Lord’s
    word with dignity and purity, misappropriating nothing at all for evil desire.[a] They always walked

    with the angels.[b]”'

      angels without inserting a detailed account of the afterlife.
